title: 1-2-3 Check: Enhancing Contextual Privacy in LLM via Multi-Agent Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and improving LLM adherence to 'contextual privacy norms' using the theory of Contextual Integrity. Benchmarking how models respect socio-ethical norms regarding sensitive information flow in various human contexts (legal, medical, financial) constitutes an evaluation of ethical behavior and normative alignment in AI.
